content.title: Xpeng Shares Surge on Optimism Over Progress in Humanoid Robots
content.summary: The company’s American depositary receipts surged 16% on Monday, buoyed also by a broad advance in the US market. While these innovations have yet to translate into near-term earnings gains, they are reshaping market perceptions of Xpeng’s valuation.
